The '''Chamber of Dark Visions''' was part of the [[Scardia Station]] a cubical [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that served as headquarters for the [[Church of the Dark Side]]. In this chamber, the false [[Supreme Prophet]], the pseudo-[[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]], gathered his prophets to let them hear his so-called prophecies. The room's floor was made of cold metal, and the fake Kadann's throne was located on a raised dais hidden behind a glowing [[Color/Legends|red]] curtain.
